artworks.title: Landscape with the Fall of Icarus
artworks.description: Bruegel's ploughman and ship sail on while Icarus' legs vanish in the sea — Ovid's middle path ignored, the world indifferent to the fall.

artworks.title: Daedalus and Icarus
artworks.description: Van Dyck shows the father fastening wax and feathers — the warning spoken before the boy climbed too close to the sun.
